item.title: Pursuing Purity in a Digital World
item.description: Temptation is no longer distant or occasional. In a digital world filled with constant access, private screens, and endless distractions, Christians face unique challenges in pursuing holiness. Anchored in Psalm 101:3, this episode shows that purity begins in the heart and is sustained through wise boundaries, godly habits, honest accountability, and delighting in Christ above all.

item.title: Fighting Temptation With the Word of God
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how Christians can fight temptation biblically using Scripture. Drawing from Psalm 119:11 and Jesus' example in Matthew 4, this episode teaches how believers resist sin by knowing, believing, speaking, and obeying God's Word.

item.title: Psalm 15 — Who May Dwell with God?
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 15 and explains who may dwell in the presence of the Lord. This episode highlights the holiness of God, the character He requires, and how Christ fulfills Psalm 15 by granting believers access to God through His righteousness.

item.title: How the Local Church Strengthens the Christian Family
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains how God designed the family and the local church to flourish together through faithful preaching, discipleship, and biblical fellowship.
